title: The Four Agreements
author: Don Miguel Ruiz
blurb: Don Miguel Ruiz draws on ancient Toltec wisdom to explain why so many of us feel stuck in fear, guilt and self-judgment. He argues that from childhood we are domesticated. Parents, schools and society teach us thousands of beliefs, or agreements, about who we are and how the world works. We accept them without question, and an inner Judge and Victim enforce them, punishing us for falling short. Ruiz calls this shared reality the dream of the planet. To wake up, he offers four new agreements: be impeccable with your word, don't take anything personally, don't make assumptions, and always do your best. Each one targets a common source of suffering. Practised patiently, and forgiven when we slip, they help break old agreements and let us live with more freedom, honesty and love.

lessons.t: You Are Living a Dream You Didn't Choose
lessons.b: From childhood we are domesticated into thousands of beliefs, or agreements, that shape how we see ourselves and the world, and most of them we never chose.

lessons.t: Meet Your Inner Judge and Victim
lessons.b: An inner Judge enforces our learned rules and an inner Victim carries the guilt and shame, punishing us again and again for the same mistake.
Your word has creative power, so speak with integrity, avoid gossip, and never use words against yourself or others.
